24671c8c.yl: Yield: 100 plates · Portion: 305 g per plate
c: Pin-bone; dust skin side in flour; pan-fry skin side in batches 2 min; finish combi 180 °C 3 min.
Brown butter to hazelnut; add almonds until golden; stop with lemon; parsley at service; hold 60 °C.
Blanch beans; ice; regen with shallot butter.
Rice potatoes; beat in hot milk, butter and lemon zest.
Plate-up: 100 plates on a 6-chef line in ≤ 12 min (one chef per component, head chef checks every 10th plate).
24671c8c.st: Fish portioned on the day, 0–2 °C; garnishes cook-chill 0–3 °C ≤ 48 h, regen to ≥ 75 °C. Fish finished in batches of 25; serve within 10 min.
24671c8c.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 4 Fish (trout fillet) · 7 Milk (butter, milk 3%) · 8 Nuts (almonds)

10a7d762.yl: Yield: 100 plates · Portion: 345 g per plate
c: Brown cheeks; colour vegetables and paste; deglaze wine and Madeira.
Add demi-glace and stock; braise 150 °C 3 h; cool in liquor.
Reduce strained liquor to 5 L; cook-chill cheeks in sauce.
Whisk polenta into boiling milk and stock; cook 40 min, stirring; finish with butter and Parmesan.
Hold covered at 70 °C ≤ 2 h; loosen with hot stock.
Chop parsley, zest and garlic fine; bind with oil.
Wilt spinach in butter to order.
Plate-up: 100 plates on a 6-chef line in ≤ 12 min (one chef per component, head chef checks every 10th plate).
10a7d762.st: Cook-chill: blast-chill < 5 °C within 90 min, vac-pack, 0–3 °C ≤ 48 h. Plate cold, cover; regen combi 140 °C, 70% steam, 12–15 min to core ≥ 75 °C (meat cooked pink: last-minute sear instead); heated cart ≥ 63 °C ≤ 20 min.
10a7d762.al: 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter, parmesan) · 9 Celery (veal demi-glace, chicken stock) · 14 Sulphites (white wine, madeira)

819ce7ff.yl: Yield: 100 plates · Portion: 120 g per plate
c: Cream butter and sugar 8 min; add eggs slowly; fold in flour, baking powder, milk.
Bake 160 °C (15 cm 35 min, 20 cm 45 min, 25 cm 55 min); cool; wrap; chill overnight.
Cook raspberries with ⅔ sugar; add pectin mixed with the rest; boil 2 min; cool.
Heat whites and sugar to 70 °C; whip to cool; beat in soft butter; add melted white chocolate.
Level and split sponges in 3; soak with syrup; fill jam + buttercream; crumb-coat; chill; final coat.
Dowel the 20 and 25 cm tiers; stack on site; slices 2.5 × 5 cm.
819ce7ff.st: Assembled cake 0–5 °C ≤ 48 h. Out of the fridge 1 h before cutting; display ≤ 3 h at ≤ 22 °C.
819ce7ff.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs, egg whites) · 6 Soybeans (white chocolate) · 7 Milk (butter, milk 3%, white chocolate). Contains gluten, eggs, milk; may contain nuts (pastry kitchen).

a8de50e8.yl: Yield: 100 plates · Portion: 240 g per plate
c: Sweat onion, leek, garlic in butter; add mushrooms; colour lightly 15 min.
Add potatoes, stock, thyme; simmer 25 min; add cream; blend; pass.
Adjust thickness with stock to coat a spoon.
Whip cream soft with truffle paste and salt.
Sauté mushrooms hard in butter; keep warm.
Bowls: mushrooms, soup poured at the table or pass, 10 g cream, chives.
a8de50e8.st: Blast-chill; 0–3 °C 3 days. Reheat to ≥ 75 °C; hold bain-marie ≥ 63 °C ≤ 2 h; serve in warmed bowls.
a8de50e8.al: 7 Milk (butter, cream 35%). Vegetarian with vegetable stock.
